subject: health
concept: Understanding that trying new physical activities can be fun, even ones that feel hard at first
source_inspiration: original content, connecting to the Resilience Pillar — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student tries a new physical activity they haven't done before and reflects on the experience
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a 'first try' feeling to how it might change after practicing more
exercise.abstract: Student explains why an activity that feels hard at first can become more fun with practice

misconception_flags: believes an activity that's difficult at first should always be avoided rather than practiced

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
